interpretation: The current VLESS-only application profile is a verified configuration gap; it does not establish what protocol, exit, mode or target produced the previous user-observed Fast 200 Mbps.
The reviewed historical tests use Cloudflare or an SSH transfer, not a historical Fast/Netflix endpoint. Their bounded startup-inclusive rates cannot identify or invalidate the user Fast result.
Do not attribute the full 200 -> 5.2 Mbps change solely to TCP selection without establishing the prior measurement path.
The bounded current Fast comparison can show current same-target TCP versus HY2 behavior; it cannot retroactively establish the historical 200 Mbps path.
Delivering a prepared HY2 full profile is an initial configuration fix. It is distinct from changing the active FlClash profile, which remains unchanged by this audit.
